type ObjectBound<T> = T extends infer U extends {next: U} ? U : 'no';
type ArrayBound<T> = T extends infer U extends U[] ? U : 'no';
type TupleBound<T> = T extends infer U extends [U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedObject<T> = T extends [infer U extends {next: U}, infer U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedArray<T> = T extends [infer U extends U[], infer U] ? U : 'no';
type RepeatedTuple<T> = T extends [infer U extends [U], infer U] ? U : 'no';

console.log('done');
